test_objective: Check that the @context is obtained from a Link Header if the Content-Type header is "application/json"

test_cases.name: 003_04_01 Create a batch of one entity using a provided Link header with JSON content type and retrieve the entity with context detail
test_cases.doc: Check that the @context is obtained from a Link Header if the Content-Type header is "application/json"
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}

test_cases.name: 003_04_02 Create a batch of one entity using a provided Link header with JSON content type and retrieve the entity without context detail
test_cases.doc: Check that the @context is obtained from a Link Header if the Content-Type header is "application/json"
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}'
}
